bio.text: Matt Loesby is the Libertarian candidate for U.S. Senate in Idaho in 2026.
According to his campaign website, he grew up in a suburb south of Denver, Colorado, worked in video game development until 2018, and bought a house in Idaho's Treasure Valley in 2020.
His website says he does administrative work and activism for the Libertarian Party of Idaho.
